name: com.glancedesk/tools
title: GlanceDesk
description: Checked calculators for money, tax, crypto, engineering and compliance, each with formula and source

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Find GlanceDesk calculators and compliance checks by topic, for example "UAE gratuity", "Pakistan salary tax", "loan EMI", "e-invoicing Saudi", "crypto liquidation price", "concrete mix cement bags". Returns each tool's slug, title, one-line description, page URL and which tool runs it.

query.description: Words describing what the person wants to work out. Empty lists every tool.

product.description: calculators = GlanceDesk Calculators (money, tax, loans, conversions); jurisdiction = GlanceDesk Jurisdiction (compliance, labour law); crypto = GlanceDesk Crypto (futures, spot, staking, fees, crypto units; user-typed prices, not investment advice); compute = GlanceDesk Compute (engineering estimates for civil, electrical, mechanical and HVAC work; not a design check). Default any.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get everything about one GlanceDesk tool before running it: its inputs (types, units, options, min/max) as JSON Schema, outputs, formula or legal rule, official sources with URLs, last-checked date, disclaimer, page URL and a worked example computed by the tool itself.

tools.name: run_calculator
tools.description: Run one GlanceDesk Calculators, GlanceDesk Crypto or GlanceDesk Compute calculator with the person's values and get the tested answer with units, a one-sentence explanation, the formula, official sources, last-checked date, page URL and disclaimer. Invalid or missing values return the calculator's own error message; nothing is guessed or filled in.

inputs.description: Field id to value, as listed by get_tool. Numbers may be given as numbers or as text like "10,000"; dates as YYYY-MM-DD; options by their value.

tools.name: gulf_final_settlement
tools.description: Work out what a private-sector worker is owed when a job ends in Saudi Arabia, the UAE or Qatar: end-of-service award or gratuity, unpaid wages, unused leave and overtime, each line with its labour-law article, plus a claim summary. Uses GlanceDesk Jurisdiction's tested engine.

country.description: sa = Saudi Arabia (Labor Law, Royal Decree M/51), ae = United Arab Emirates (Federal Decree-Law 33 of 2021, private sector), qa = Qatar (Labour Law, Law No. 14 of 2004).

last_day.description: Last day of work, YYYY-MM-DD. Both days count as service.

basic_monthly_wage.description: Last basic monthly wage, without allowances (SAR, AED or QAR). The UAE and Qatar gratuity and leave pay use this.

total_monthly_wage.description: Last total monthly wage: basic plus contractual allowances. The Saudi award and leave pay use this. Must be at least the basic wage.

how_it_ended.description: employer = the employer ended the contract (not for misconduct); expired = fixed-term contract ended, not renewed; resign = the worker resigned; breach = the worker left because the employer broke the contract or law (Saudi Art. 81, UAE Art. 45); exception = Saudi only: force majeure, or a female worker leaving within 6 months of marriage or 3 months of giving birth; misconduct = dismissed without notice for a reason the law lists (Saudi Art. 80, UAE Art. 44, Qatar Art. 61).

unpaid_wage_months.description: Optional. Months of wages not paid (decimals for part months).

unused_leave_days.description: Optional. Unused annual leave days earned, including this year's share.

normal_hours_per_day.description: Needed only with overtime: normal working hours per day in the contract.

night_overtime_hours.description: UAE or Qatar, optional: how many of the overtime hours were at night (UAE 10 pm to 4 am, Qatar 9 pm to 3 am; not for shift workers).

unpaid_absence_days.description: UAE only, optional: days of unpaid absence (not counted as service).

tools.name: einvoicing_check
tools.description: Check whether e-invoicing applies to a business and its deadline: Saudi ZATCA Phase 1 and Phase 2 waves, UAE e-invoicing phases (Ministerial Decisions 243 and 244 of 2025), Pakistan FBR electronic invoicing (S.R.O. 1852(I)/2025). Every line cites its legal reference and official source; unconfirmed facts are marked "Being verified" and not used.

country.description: sa = Saudi Arabia (ZATCA), ae = United Arab Emirates (MoF/FTA), pk = Pakistan (FBR).

resident.description: Saudi Arabia: is the business resident in Saudi Arabia?

vat_registered.description: Saudi Arabia or UAE: is the business registered for VAT there?

revenue_by_year.description: Saudi Arabia: revenue subject to VAT (SAR) for each year the ZATCA waves use: 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025. Leave a year out if not trading.

conducts_business_in_uae.description: UAE: does the person conduct business in the UAE?

entity_type.description: UAE: business, or gov = government entity.

revenue.description: UAE: gross revenue in the most recent accounting period (AED).

customers.description: Who you invoice: b2b = businesses, b2g = government, b2c = consumers.

sales_tax_registered.description: Pakistan: registered for sales tax with the FBR?

business_type.description: Pakistan: public = public listed company, company = other company, individual = individual or association of persons.

imports_goods.description: Pakistan: does the business import goods?

turnover.description: Pakistan: turnover declared in sales tax returns for the last twelve months (PKR).

tools.name: breach_notification_deadline
tools.description: Work out the GDPR / UK GDPR Article 33 deadline for notifying a personal data breach: 72 elapsed hours from becoming aware, given as local time in the person's time zone (IANA zone with daylight saving, or a fixed UTC offset) and in UTC. Returns the deadline, which authority to notify (lead authority, every EU authority where affected people live, or the UK Information Commission), the steps for a controller or processor with their article references, official sources, last-checked date and page link. Uses GlanceDesk Jurisdiction's tested deadline module.

aware.description: When the organisation became aware of the personal data breach: local date and time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in time_zone (or utc_offset).

role.description: controller = decides why and how the data is used; processor = handles the data for a client.

scope.description: Which apply (any combination): eu_main = EU GDPR, main establishment in the EU; eu_none = EU GDPR, no establishment in the EU (serves EU users from outside); uk = UK GDPR, affected people in the UK. Empty or left out = all three. Decides which authority is notified.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the person, e.g. "Europe/London", "Asia/Karachi", "America/Los_Angeles". Daylight saving time is applied. Give this or utc_offset; with neither, times are UTC.

utc_offset.description: Fixed offset from UTC instead of time_zone, e.g. "+05:00" or "-04:00" (no daylight-saving changes). Default "+00:00" (UTC).

tools.name: data_request_deadline
tools.description: Work out the deadline to answer a data subject or consumer request: EU GDPR and UK GDPR Article 12(3) (one month, extendable by two further months; UK Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 changes), or California CCPA/CPRA (confirm within 10 business days, respond within 45 days with one 45-day extension; opt-out or limit requests within 15 business days). Returns each date with its legal reference, the steps, official sources, last-checked date and page link. Uses GlanceDesk Jurisdiction's tested deadline module.

law.description: eu = EU GDPR, uk = UK GDPR, ccpa = California CCPA/CPRA.

request_type.description: CCPA only (required for ccpa): know = know/access, delete or correct; optout = opt out of sale/sharing, or limit use of sensitive data. Not used for eu or uk.

received.description: Local date the request was received, YYYY-MM-DD.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the person, e.g. "Europe/London", "Asia/Karachi", "America/Los_Angeles". Daylight saving time is applied. Give this or utc_offset; with neither, times are UTC.

utc_offset.description: Fixed offset from UTC instead of time_zone, e.g. "+05:00" or "-04:00" (no daylight-saving changes). Default "+00:00" (UTC).

tools.name: business_filing_deadline
tools.description: Work out a business tax filing deadline and estimate the late penalty: Pakistan income tax return (Income Tax Ordinance s.118 with official FBR extensions; s.182 penalty) and quarterly withholding statements (s.165), UAE Corporate Tax return and payment (9 months after the tax period; registration deadline under FTA Decision 3/2024; Cabinet Decision 75/2023 penalties), UAE VAT return and payment (28th day after the tax period; Cabinet Decision 40/2017 as amended by Cabinet Decision 129/2025), Saudi VAT tax period and due date (Implementing Regulations Arts. 58, 59, 62, 74; VAT Law penalties). Every line cites its legal reference and official source; unconfirmed facts are marked "Being verified" and not used. Uses GlanceDesk Jurisdiction's tested filing module.

filing.description: Which deadline: pk_income_tax_return = Pakistan income tax return (Income Tax Ordinance s.118, penalty s.182); pk_withholding_statement = Pakistan quarterly withholding statement (s.165); uae_corporate_tax = UAE Corporate Tax return and payment (Federal Decree-Law 47/2022) with optional registration deadline; uae_vat = UAE VAT return and payment (VAT Executive Regulation Art. 64); saudi_vat = Saudi VAT tax period, return and payment (VAT Implementing Regulations Arts. 58, 59, 62).

taxpayer_type.description: pk_income_tax_return: company; salaried = individual with 75% or more of income from salary; other = other individual or association of persons (AOP).

tax_year_end.description: pk_income_tax_return: last day of the tax year (normal tax year ends 30 June, e.g. 2026-06-30 = tax year 2026; special tax years end on another month end). Date as YYYY-MM-DD.

tax_payable.description: pk_income_tax_return: tax payable for the year in PKR (the higher of assessed tax and the last duly filed year's tax). Needed with filed to estimate the late-filing penalty.

quarter_end_month.description: pk_withholding_statement: month the quarter ends (3 = March, 6 = June, 9 = September, 12 = December).

year.description: pk_withholding_statement: calendar year the quarter ends in, e.g. 2026.

withheld_tax_paid_on_time.description: pk_withholding_statement, with filed: yes = the tax withheld or collected was paid by its due date; no = it was not; nil = no tax was required to be withheld or collected.

period_end.description: uae_corporate_tax, uae_vat, saudi_vat: last day of the tax period (Saudi: a month end). Date as YYYY-MM-DD.

incorporated.description: uae_corporate_tax, optional: date the business was set up (checks the FTA Decision 7/2024 postponement for first tax periods ending on or before 29 February 2024). Date as YYYY-MM-DD.

registration_type.description: uae_corporate_tax, optional (gives the registration deadline, FTA Decision 3/2024): res_new = resident company set up on or after 1 March 2024; res_old = resident company set up before 1 March 2024 (registration_start = issue date of its earliest licence); res_foreign = foreign company managed and controlled in the UAE (registration_start = end of its financial year); nr_pe = non-resident with a permanent establishment (registration_start = date the PE came into existence); nr_nexus = non-resident with a nexus (date the nexus was established); np_res = resident individual doing business with turnover over AED 1 million (a date in the calendar year the threshold was passed); np_nr = non-resident individual (date the conditions were met).

registration_start.description: uae_corporate_tax, with registration_type: the date that starts the registration period (see registration_type). Date as YYYY-MM-DD.

repeat_within_24_months.description: uae_vat, with filed: true if a late return was already penalised in the previous 24 months.

taxable_supplies_12m.description: saudi_vat: value of taxable supplies in the last 12 months in SAR (over SAR 40,000,000 = monthly tax period).

monthly_approved.description: saudi_vat: true if ZATCA approved or directed a monthly tax period although supplies are not over SAR 40,000,000.

vat_due.description: saudi_vat, with filed or paid: VAT due for the period in SAR (to estimate the fines).

unpaid_tax.description: uae_corporate_tax, uae_vat, with paid: tax paid late, in AED.

filed.description: Optional: date the return or statement was or will be filed (estimates the late-filing penalty). Date as YYYY-MM-DD.

paid.description: Optional: date the tax was or will be paid (uae_corporate_tax, uae_vat with unpaid_tax; saudi_vat with vat_due). Date as YYYY-MM-DD.
